summary: ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 1 of 16** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 2 of 16** (b) For procurement of transmission services, required for inter-State transmission, the Central Government shall notify any Central Government Organization or any Central Public Sector Undertakings the Bid Process Coordinator (BPC) who would be responsible for coordinating the bid process. (c) The BPC shall prepare the bid documentation in accordance with the Guidelines and obtain approval of the Appropriate Commission or alternatively, the BPC can use the standard bid documents notified by the Ministry of Power. Approval of the Appropriate Commission would be necessary if any material deviation is proposed to be made in the Standard Bid Documents. Intimation about the initiation of the bid process shall be sent by the BPC to the Appropriate Commission. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 3 of 16** (g) Standard documentations to be provided by BPC in the RFP shall include specified target dates/months for commissioning and commercial operations and start of providing transmission services. TSA proposed to be entered with the selected bidder; bid evaluation methodology to be adopted by the BPC; Discount ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 4 of 16** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 5 of 16** (k) The BPC shall make evaluation of the bid public by indicating the terms of the winning bid and anonymous comparison of all other bids. All contracts signed with the successful bidder shall also be made public. The final TSA along with the certification of BPC shall be forwarded to the Appropriate Commission for adoption of tariff in terms of section 63 of the Act. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 6 of 16** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 7 of 16** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 8 of 16** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 9 of 16** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in Petition No.121/AT/2016 10 of 16** 18. title: Application under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for adoption of transmission charges with respect to the Transmission System established by North Karanpura Transco Limited. North Karanpura Transco Limited.
